title: Acid-catalysed rearrangement of acyl groups: synthesis of β-D-gluco aminocyclopentitols and carbanucleoside derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,40390-40399
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05811B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tapas Halder, Ratul Hore, Susanta Das, Subhadip Sett, Joykrishna Maity
Syntheses of β-D-gluco aminocyclopentitols and carbanucleosides through functional group manipulation of carbohydrate-derived isoxazolidine derivatives are reported. During the process, acid-catalysed acyl group rearrangement was observed.
